intro: The Song of Solomon is a love poem: a celebration of love between a bride and her beloved.
Across eight short chapters, they speak to each other with longing and delight.
Many readers, Jewish and Christian, have also heard in it a picture of God's love for his people. Listen for the line in chapter eight: love is strong as death.

card.parts: Ch. 1–8: a song in eight parts
card.key: The rose of Sharon (2) · My beloved is mine (2) · Love is strong as death (8)
